title: Most Valuable Green Bay Packers Football Cards Ever Sold, Ranked (Titletown Grails)
body_markdown:
[Bart Starr](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Bart%20Starr&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) was the 200th pick in the 1956 NFL Draft. 70 years later, his rookie card is the most expensive Green Bay Packers card ever sold.


Considering the Packers are tied for the third-most Super Bowl wins, and the team is the third-oldest franchise in the league—featuring a number of all-time greats at virtually every position—that’s saying something.


The 1957 Topps Bart Starr #119 rookie card, graded SGC 9, sold at Heritage Auctions in January of 2026 for $384,300, topping the $288,000 that a PSA 9 copy brought in back in 2017. Starr isn’t the only quarterback near the top of the best-selling Packers cards, either. All five of the highest verified sales for Packers cards feature a QB: Bart Starr (twice),[Aaron Rodgers](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Aaron%20Rodgers&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) , who backed up[Brett Favre](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Brett%20Favre&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) , and[Jordan Love](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Jordan%20Love&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) , who backed up Rodgers. A whole lot of[NFL](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=football) teams wish they’d been able to draft (or develop) legendary signal-callers like that.


Rank Card Name Year Grade Record Sale


1 Bart Starr Topps Rookie Card #119 1957 SGC 9 $384,300


2 Bart Starr Topps Rookie Card #119 1957 PSA 9 $288,000


3 Aaron Rodgers SP Authentic Rookie Patch Auto Gold /25 2005 Not reported $225,000


4 Brett Favre Metal Universe Precious Metal Gems Green #156 1997 PSA 9 $146,400


5 Jordan Love National Treasures Rookie Patch Auto NFL Shield 1/1 2020 PSA Authentic (Auto 9) $144,000


Below is a list of the most expensive cards featuring a Packers legend, either in a Packers jersey or in the jersey of the team they played for before (or after) their time in Green Bay, ranked by the highest verified sale. That includes Favre, who started his career with the Atlanta Falcons, and[Reggie White](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Reggie%20White&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) , “The Minister of Defense,” who played for the Philadelphia Eagles before moving to the Midwest.


Now, for the moment you’ve all been waiting for:[Go Pack Go!](https://www.facebook.com/reel/1119518523850486)


## **The Top-5 Most Valuable Cards Featuring Packers Legends:**


### **1. 1957 Topps**[Bart Starr](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Bart%20Starr&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **Rookie Card #119 (SGC 9) – FMV: $384,300**


Starr wasn’t a hyped up draft pick back in 1957, going in the 17th round. It then took him another two years to win the starting quarterback position upon the arrival of legendary coach Vince Lombardi in 1959. His 1957 Topps rookie is his only recognized rookie card—a rarity when it comes to[vintage football cards](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=football) , which can have a heated debate about a player’s *true* rookie card—and finding it in a high grade is incredibly rare: SGC has graded just two copies as a 9, and none higher.


Want a piece of the Starr market for yourself?[Browse every Bart Starr on Courtyard.io’s marketplace](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Bart%20Starr&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) , or take your shot at pulling a Starr from one of our[digital football packs](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=football) . In fact, a 1957 Topps Starr Rookie (PSA 7.5) with a fair market value of $5,026 was pulled from one of[Courtyard.io’s Sports Mythic Packs](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine/sports-mythic-pack) in the 2026.


### **2. 1957 Topps**[Bart Starr](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Bart%20Starr&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **Rookie Card #119 (PSA 9) – FMV: $288,000**


Heritage sold this Starr rookie card as well, fetching $288,000 at auction back in 2017—a then Packers card record. The card remains among the most expensive[vintage football cards](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=football) ever sold.


### **3. 2005 SP Authentic**[Aaron Rodgers](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Aaron%20Rodgers&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **Rookie Patch Auto Gold /25 – FMV: $225,000**


Rodgers’ highest public sale is the Gold parallel of his 2005 SP Authentic rookie patch autograph, numbered to 25 copies. It sold for $225,000 in December of 2021, in the midst of one of Rodgers’ four MVP seasons. The future NFL Hall of Fame quarterback has two public sales for $100,000 or more, but the highest sale of a Rodgers card since 2021 is $39,600 for his 2005 Bowman Chrome Gold Refractor Rookie Autograph 1/1, which sold in 2023.


Ready to get a Rodgers of your own? There’s a 2005 Topps Turkey Red #221 Aaron Rodgers Rookie Card (PSA 10 GEM MINT) available on[Courtyard.io’s marketplace](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Aaron%20Rodgers&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) .


### **4. 1997 SkyBox Metal Universe Precious Metal Gems Green #156**[Brett Favre](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Brett%20Favre&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **(PSA 9) – FMV: $146,400**


Most forget that Packers legend Brett Favre wasn’t actually drafted by the Cheeseheads. Maybe that’s why this is the only cardboard on the list that’s not a rookie card. This PSA 9 insert from the year after Favre won Super Bowl XXXI sold at Heritage in March of 2026, more than doubling its previous price, according to[Rorz Cards](https://www.rorzcards.com/the-most-valuable-football-cards-of-the-1990s/) . The Green parallel is numbered to just 15 copies, according to[Collector Nation](https://thecollectornation.com/analysis/most-valuable-brett-favre-cards) , making this insert, which rarely grades as high as a 9, that much more rare. Interestingly, Favre’s rookie cards have a completely different market, with his 1991 Wild Card Draft “1000” Stripe (PSA 10) setting a card record at ‘just’ $18,600 in February of 2026, per[Sports Illustrated](https://www.si.com/collectibles/1991-wild-card-brett-favre-1000-stripe-psa-10-rc-sets-new-record) .


Favre’s storied career means plenty of collectors. From rookie cards to cardboard featuring his time for the Packers, there are plenty of Favre cards available via fellow collectors on[Courtyard.io’s marketplace](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Brett%20Favre&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) .


### **5. 2020 Panini National Treasures**[Jordan Love](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Jordan%20Love&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **Rookie Patch Auto NFL Shield 1/1 Rookie Card (PSA Authentic) – FMV: $144,000**


Love’s one-of-one National Treasures NFL Shield rookie patch auto sold at Fanatics Collect in August of 2024 for $144,000, just months after his breakout 2023 season—his first as a starter, following Aaron Rodgers’ departure to New York. While the Packers are among the most popular teams in the league, and Love is just entering his prime, this card marks his only six-figure sale on record. Before that, his best was $28,800 for a 2020 Prizm Black Finite 1/1 auto that a father and son duo pulled from a pack at The National Sports Card Convention in Chicago in 2023 and sold a month later.


Want to get a Jordan Love rookie card of your own? There’s a 2020 Panini Contenders #111 Jordan Love - Variation Autograph Cracked Ice (PSA 10 GEM MINT) valued at more than $20,000 waiting in[Courtyard.io’s Football Legend Pack](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine/football-legend-pack) ($2,500).


**Runner’s up:**[Bart Starr](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Bart%20Starr&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) ’s SGC 9 rookie also sold for $53,433 in 2020, and for $50,400 at Fanatics Collect in 2024.[Aaron Rodgers](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Aaron%20Rodgers&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) ’ 2023 Bowman Chrome 1/1 went for $39,600, while[Jordan Love](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Jordan%20Love&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) ’s National Treasures Stars & Stripes Rookie Patch Auto /3 (PSA 10) sold for $24,600 in 2025. Once again, quarterbacks call the shots.


## **The Best-Selling Packers Cards from the Rest of the Roster**


Quarterbacks might be the most notable position in football, but they don’t own the whole football card market. Collectors have also paid up for Packers Hall of Famers from the Lombardi era and beyond. Here are some of the green and yellow greats.


### **1957 Topps**[Paul Hornung](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Paul%20Hornung&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **Rookie Card #151 (PSA 9) – FMV: $23,962**


Hornung might not be a household name today, but he won the Heisman Trophy at Notre Dame back in 1956, and he shares the 1957 Topps set with Starr. PSA has graded 12 copies of this card as a 9, but none have achieved a GEM MINT. This one sold at Mile High Card Company in December 2014, and given the market’s evolution since then, it’d be interesting to see what it sells for today.


### **1984 Topps USFL #58**[Reggie White](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Reggie%20White&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **Rookie Card (PSA 10) – FMV: $23,700**


White's rookie card shows the Minister of Defense in an Eagles jersey, years before he played for Green Bay—and a year after Topps minted his 1985 USFL rookie card during his time as a Memphis Showboat. Only 43 copies of the Topps rookie have earned a PSA 10, and one of those went for nearly $24,000 in March of 2021, according to[The New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/3266135/2022/04/25/old-school-topps-usfl-cards-drive-high-prices-amid-the-current-boom-but-a-usfl-2-0-set-isnt-coming-yet/) . Don’t worry, there are plenty of more affordable NFL rookie cards available on[Courtyard.io’s marketplace](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Reggie%20White&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) .


### **1963 Topps**[Ray Nitschke](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Ray%20Nitschke&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **Rookie Card #96 (PSA 9) – FMV: $11,000**


Another bygone legend of the gridiron, Nitschke's rookie card didn’t arrive until his sixth season in the NFL. PSA has graded 13 copies as a 9, but none as a 10. One of those PSA 9s featuring the Packers Hall of Famer sold for $11,000 in August of 2023, according to[Sports Card Investor](https://www.sportscardinvestor.com/cards/ray-nitschke-football/1963-topps-base-96/psa-9) .


### **1966 Philadelphia**[Jim Taylor](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Jim%20Taylor&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **#89 (PSA 9) – FMV: $5,181**


A fullback made the list! We repeat: a fullback made the list! This PSA 9 from Jim Taylor sold at Mile High Card Company in December 2014.


**Affordable options:** Not every rookie card from a Packers great has to cost a pretty penny. Charles Woodson, the former University of Michigan standout, who famously emulated Desmond Howard’s Heisman pose before winning it for himself, has an inexpensive rookie card: PSA 10 copies of his 1998 Stadium Club rookie card sell for between $39 - $65.
